decisions.decision: The Board tabled the capital plan request for updating the Master Plan for a future discussion with the Planning Board, because the Planning Board did not list it on its agenda.
decisions.quote: this item was tabled for a future discussion with the planning board because they did not list it on their meeting agenda.

decisions.decision: The Chair said he would place the marijuana ballot question on the agenda again with the full Board and invited the Planning Board to come back.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant, a payroll warrant and a deductions warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $553,525.91, a payroll warrant in the amount of $879,649. 64 and a deductions warrant in the amount of $578,528.18.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commissioner Menard said the funding mentioned when the students first presented in February was $100,000.
budget_items.quote: the funding mentioned was $100,000 and a location had not yet been decided upon.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Caiozzo said the skate park committee's rough approximation for a 7,500 square foot facility was $250,000, the figure presented to the Selectmen two months later.
budget_items.quote: came up with an area of 7,500 square feet at a cost of $250,000 which was a rough approximation.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members discussed long-term maintenance costs, limited town resources and the growing size and expense of the skate park project; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: there is still the cost of long-term maintenance.
